title: Patient Comfort Kit Assembly
description: High school volunteer volunteers and pre-med pathway students assist hospital staff in assembling comfort kits and hygiene packages for pediatric and adult patients. Volunteers will also assist with wayfinding, registration desk support, and organizing patient wellness supplies in Frisco, TX. Suitable for teens 14-18 earning NHS and pre-health hours.

title: Blood Drive Check-In Volunteer
description: Youth and student volunteers greet blood donors, manage check-in rosters, provide post-donation refreshments, and ensure a welcoming environment during community mobile blood drives across Collin County and McKinney, TX. Great for students pursuing healthcare careers.

title: Senior Center Health Fair Greeter
description: Support our annual health & wellness fair in Allen, TX! Volunteers assist elderly community members with navigation, guide participants to wellness screening booths, and distribute educational health literature. Teens and student volunteers welcome.

title: Saturday Food Pantry Sort
description: Join our Food Pantry shift in Frisco, TX! High school student volunteers inspect, date-check, categorize, and shelve donated pantry staples, produce, and household goods to support local families facing hunger. Ideal for NHS and teen service clubs.

title: Perot Family Campus Box Packing Shift
description: Student and youth volunteers pack food boxes and assemble nutritious family emergency kits at the NTFB distribution facility in Plano, TX. Each shift helps provide thousands of meals to children and seniors across North Texas.

title: Towne Lake Trail Maintenance & Tree Planting
description: Volunteer outdoor workday with the McKinney Parks Foundation! Volunteers will help with prairie conservation, mulching nature trails, planting native saplings, and general park cleanup along scenic McKinney, TX trails. Perfect for teens and environmental clubs.

title: Community Meal Packing Night
description: Help ensure FISD students do not go hungry over the weekend! Volunteers assemble non-perishable weekend food packs for FISD school children in Frisco, TX. High school students, groups, and families welcome.

title: VolunTEEN Program
description: The VolunTEEN Corps offers high school students (Grades 9-12) civic involvement and library service in Frisco, TX. VolunTEENs assist with youth maker programs, book inventory, digital learning labs, and community literacy outreach.
